Cancellation & Refund Policy

Clear & fair booking rules — print, copy, or download easily.
Policy v1.0

Please read this cancellation policy carefully before confirming any booking. The following rules apply to all tours, activities, transfers, and room reservations.

1) Cancellation more than 48 hours before
Flexible — Full Refund
If cancellation is requested more than 48 hours before the service time, you will receive a full refund with no administrative fees.
2) Cancellation between 24–48 hours
Partial — 50% Refund
If cancellation occurs within 24 to 48 hours before the service time, 50% of the total amount will be refunded.
3) Less than 24 hours or No-Show
Non-Refundable
Cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the service, or failure to attend (no-show), are non-refundable.
4) Weather conditions & safety
May affect schedule
In the event of harsh weather or safety risks, the provider may reschedule or cancel the service. Customers will be offered a new date or a full/partial refund depending on the situation.
5) Special offers and non-refundable deals
Specific Terms
Discounts, promotional prices, or limited offers may have different cancellation rules. These conditions will be mentioned clearly during booking.
6) Cancellation by the provider
Refund or Replacement
If the provider cancels the service due to internal reasons, the customer will receive a full refund or an alternative option.
7) How to request a cancellation
Simple & Quick
To cancel a booking, please contact us via WhatsApp or email and provide the booking number and service details. Requests are processed within 24 business hours.
8) Refund processing time
Secure
Refunds are issued using the original payment method and may take 7–14 business days depending on the bank or payment provider.

For assistance or urgent requests, please contact us via WhatsApp or email and provide your booking number. We are always happy to help.

Camel ride

Drive Back to Hotel

tours.title: Cairo by Bus
tours.renderedPageText:
Cairo by Bus
Depart for Cairo:
Begin your adventure with a comfortable bus ride to Cairo. As you travel, enjoy the scenic views of the lush Nile Valley and the surrounding landscapes, setting the stage for the rich history you are about to explore.
• Egyptian Museum
Your first stop is the renowned Egyptian Museum, which houses over 120,000 artifacts spanning from the Prehistoric to Roman Greek eras. Under the expert guidance of our knowledgeable Egyptologist, you’ll delve into the fascinating stories behind stunning sculptures, exquisite jewelry, and priceless gold artifacts, including the treasures of Tutankhamun. Explore the museum’s 107 rooms and learn about the ancient civilization that flourished along the Nile.
• Lunch on the Nile
• Enjoy a delightful lunch at a scenic restaurant along the Nile River. Savor traditional Egyptian dishes while taking in breathtaking views of the river, the bustling city, and its historical skyline. This is the perfect opportunity to relax and recharge before continuing your exploration.
• Papyrus and Perfume Laboratories
– After lunch, visit traditional papyrus and perfume laboratories. Here, you’ll witness artisans at work, creating beautiful papyrus scrolls and crafting exquisite perfumes using ancient techniques. Discover the significance of papyrus in ancient Egypt and learn about the fragrant essences that have been cherished for centuries. Don’t forget to pick up unique souvenirs to take home!
• Pyramids of Giza
– The highlight of your day awaits at the magnificent Giza Plateau. Marvel at the iconic Pyramids of Cheops, Chephren, and Menkaure, extraordinary funerary monuments dating back over 3,000 years. Your Egyptologist will share fascinating insights into their construction, purpose, and the mysteries that still surround them today. Stand in awe before the Great Sphinx, a symbol of mystery and beauty, captivating visitors with its majestic feline body and human-like face.
• Sunset Views and Reflection
– Take a moment to savor the breathtaking views of the pyramids as the sun begins to set, casting a golden glow over these ancient wonders. This serene moment allows you to reflect on the incredible history and culture you’ve experienced throughout the day.
• Return to Your Hotel
– After an exciting day filled with exploration and discovery, relax on the bus ride back to your hotel. Share your favorite moments with fellow travelers and enjoy the camaraderie formed through shared experiences.
